Official NFL Week 1 injury report
sources.note: Page loads but Wednesday practice designations not yet published (Week 1 starts Wed Sep 9).

Jaxson Dart.news: Not listed on Giants Week 1 injury report (CBS). Projected starting QB.

Sam Darnold.news: Not listed on Seahawks injury report (CBS). Starting QB Week 1 vs NE.

De'Von Achane.news: Not listed on Dolphins injury report (CBS).

Travis Etienne Jr..news: Not listed on Saints injury report (CBS). Rostered as NO RB for 2026.

Josh Jacobs.news: On NFL Commissioner's Exempt List (personal/legal). Cannot practice or attend games while on list; paid admin leave, does not count on 53. Packers GM anticipates he will play at some point in 2026, but Week 1 unavailable unless removed from list. ESPN Injury page lists Status Out, est. return Sep 27.

Jonathon Brooks.news: CBS: Questionable Week 1 vs CHI — general soreness (updated Tue Sep 1). HC Dave Canales said Wed Sep 2 he is 'very optimistic' Brooks will be available Week 1 (Fox Sports Radio / 4for4 / ESPN injury blurb).

Zach Charbonnet.news: Reserve/PUP recovering from left ACL tear (Jan 2026 playoffs; surgery Feb). Must miss at least first four games; earliest eligible Week 5 vs SF. CBS: Physically Unable to Perform, Expected Return Week 5. ESPN tag O aligns with unavailable Week 1.

Drake London.news: Not listed on Falcons injury report (CBS).

Garrett Wilson.news: Not listed on Jets injury report (CBS).

Michael Pittman Jr..news: CBS: Questionable Week 1 vs ATL — hamstring (updated Fri Aug 28). ESPN Brooke Pryor (Aug 31): Pittman and Metcalf 'expected to be ready' for Week 1 but team expected to 'ease in' both after missed camp/preseason time. Returned to practice late August.

Jakobi Meyers.news: CBS: Questionable Week 1 vs CLE — hand (updated Fri Aug 28). Returned to practice Wed Sep 2 (limited catching); Liam Coen indicated he was going / limited. Likely on track for Week 1 but monitor official injury report.

Rashid Shaheed.news: Not listed on Seahawks injury report (CBS).

Kyle Pitts Sr..news: Not listed on Falcons injury report (CBS).

Dallas Goedert.news: Not listed on Eagles injury report (CBS). (Grant Calcaterra on IR; Goedert not tagged.)

Steelers D/ST.news: Team defense unit; no unit-level OUT designation. Individual Steelers defenders have some Q tags (Ramsey knee, Echols ankle, Brisker undisclosed, Skowronek concussion) but D/ST still fieldable.

Critical vs ESPN tags: Jacobs is EXEMPT (not merely DTD) — ineligible while on Commissioner's Exempt List. Charbonnet confirmed Reserve/PUP (ESPN O consistent). Pittman Q but expected ready / possible snap ease-in. Brooks Q with coach optimism. Meyers Q hand, practicing limited.
